subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Fetid
solution:
The correct answer is: **Fragrant**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Fetid"** means having an unpleasant or offensive smell. (दुर्गंधयुक्त)

 
 
• **Example:** The room was fetid because of the garbage left uncleaned for days.
 
 
 
• **"Fragrant"** refers to having a pleasant or sweet smell; the opposite of fetid. (सुगंधित)
 
 
• **Example:** The garden was fragrant with the scent of blooming roses.
 
 
 
• Hence, the word "Fragrant" is the most appropriate antonym of "Fetid".

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Fragrant**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Fatigued** (थका हुआ): Extremely tired or exhausted.

 
 
• **Example:** After a long day of work, she felt fatigued and went straight to bed.
 
 
 
• **False** (झूठा): Not true, incorrect, or misleading.
 
 
• **Example:** The report contained false information about the incident.
 
 
 
• **Fatal** (घातक): Causing death or leading to failure.
 
 
• **Example:** The accident was fatal and claimed several lives.
